mapper.select: SELECT O.ORDER_ID, O.CUSTOMER_ID, C.CUSTOMER_NAME, TO_CHAR(O.ORDER_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ORDER_DATE, TO_CHAR(O.SHIP_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS SHIP_DATE, FN_FORMAT_AMOUNT(O.TOTAL_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_AMOUNT, FN_FORMAT_AMOUNT(NVL(O.TAX_AMOUNT, 0)) AS TAX_AMOUNT, FN_FORMAT_AMOUNT(O.TOTAL_AMOUNT - NVL(O.TAX_AMOUNT, 0)) AS NET_AMOUNT, O.DISCOUNT_RATE || '%' AS DISCOUNT_RATE, DECODE(O.ORDER_STATUS, 'PENDING', '대기', 'CONFIRMED', '확인', 'SHIPPED', '배송중', 'DELIVERED', '완료', 'CANCELLED', '취소', '알수없음') AS ORDER_STATUS, NVL(O.PAYMENT_METHOD, '미정') AS PAYMENT_METHOD, NVL(O.REMARKS, '') AS REMARKS, FN_GET_ORDER_TOTAL(O.ORDER_ID) AS CALCULATED_TOTAL, TO_CHAR(O.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') AS CREATED_AT FROM ORDERS O JOIN CUSTOMERS C ON O.CUSTOMER_ID = C.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE O.ORDER_ID = #{orderId}

SELECT OI.ITEM_SEQ, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.CATEGORY, OI.QUANTITY, FN_FORMAT_AMOUNT(OI.UNIT_PRICE) AS UNIT_PRICE, FN_FORMAT_AMOUNT(NVL(OI.DISCOUNT_AMT, 0)) AS DISCOUNT_AMT, FN_FORMAT_AMOUNT(OI.QUANTITY * OI.UNIT_PRICE - NVL(OI.DISCOUNT_AMT, 0)) AS LINE_TOTAL, ROUND(NVL(OI.DISCOUNT_AMT, 0) / NULLIF(OI.QUANTITY * OI.UNIT_PRICE, 0) * 100, 1) AS DISCOUNT_PCT FROM ORDER_ITEMS OI JOIN PRODUCTS P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE OI.ORDER_ID = #{orderId} ORDER BY OI.ITEM_SEQ
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_ORDER.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO ORDERS ( ORDER_ID, CUSTOMER_ID, ORDER_DATE, TOTAL_AMOUNT, TAX_AMOUNT, DISCOUNT_RATE, ORDER_STATUS, PAYMENT_METHOD, REMARKS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{customerId}, SYSDATE, 0, 0, NVL(#{discountRate}, 0), 'PENDING', #{paymentMethod}, #{remarks}, SYSTIMESTAMP )

INSERT INTO ORDER_ITEMS (ORDER_ID, ITEM_SEQ, PRODUCT_ID, QUANTITY, UNIT_PRICE, DISCOUNT_AMT) VALUES ( #{orderId}, (SELECT NVL(MAX(ITEM_SEQ), 0) + 1 FROM ORDER_ITEMS WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId}), #{productId}, #{quantity}, (SELECT UNIT_PRICE FROM PRODUCTS WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}), NVL(#{discountAmt}, 0) )
mapper.update: UPDATE ORDERS SET ORDER_STATUS = #{newStatus}, SHIP_DATE = CASE WHEN #{newStatus} = 'SHIPPED' AND SHIP_DATE IS NULL THEN SYSDATE ELSE SHIP_DATE END, UPD_DATE = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId} AND ORDER_STATUS != 'CANCELLED'
mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(O.ORDER_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') AS SALES_MONTH, SUM(DECODE(P.CATEGORY, 'ELEC', OI.QUANTITY * OI.UNIT_PRICE, 0)) AS ELEC_SALES, SUM(DECODE(P.CATEGORY, 'FOOD', OI.QUANTITY * OI.UNIT_PRICE, 0)) AS FOOD_SALES, SUM(DECODE(P.CATEGORY, 'CLOTH', OI.QUANTITY * OI.UNIT_PRICE, 0)) AS CLOTH_SALES, SUM(DECODE(P.CATEGORY, 'BOOK', OI.QUANTITY * OI.UNIT_PRICE, 0)) AS BOOK_SALES, SUM(OI.QUANTITY * OI.UNIT_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SALES FROM ORDERS O JOIN ORDER_ITEMS OI ON O.ORDER_ID = OI.ORDER_ID JOIN PRODUCTS P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE O.ORDER_STATUS != 'CANCELLED' GROUP BY TO_CHAR(O.ORDER_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY 1
mapper.update: MERGE INTO ORDERS O USING (SELECT #{orderId} AS ORDER_ID FROM DUAL) S ON (O.ORDER_ID = S.ORDER_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET O.TOTAL_AMOUNT = #{totalAmount}, O.TAX_AMOUNT = ROUND(#{totalAmount} * 0.1, 2), O.ORDER_STATUS = NVL(#{orderStatus}, O.ORDER_STATUS), O.REMARKS = NVL(#{remarks}, O.REMARKS), O.UPD_DATE = SYSTIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (ORDER_ID, CUSTOMER_ID, ORDER_DATE, TOTAL_AMOUNT, TAX_AMOUNT, ORDER_STATUS, PAYMENT_METHOD, REMARKS, CREATED_AT) VALUES (SEQ_ORDER.NEXTVAL, #{customerId}, SYSDATE, #{totalAmount}, ROUND(#{totalAmount} * 0.1, 2), NVL(#{orderStatus}, 'PENDING'), #{paymentMethod}, #{remarks}, SYSTIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: WITH DATE_RANGE AS ( SELECT TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + LEVEL - 1 AS SALE_DATE FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') - TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 ) SELECT TO_CHAR(D.SALE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS SALE_DATE, TO_CHAR(D.SALE_DATE, 'DY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=KOREAN') AS DAY_NAME, NVL(O.ORDER_CNT, 0) AS ORDER_COUNT, FN_FORMAT_AMOUNT(NVL(O.TOTAL_AMT, 0)) AS TOTAL_SALES FROM DATE_RANGE D LEFT JOIN ( SELECT TRUNC(ORDER_DATE) AS ORD_DATE, COUNT(*) AS ORDER_CNT, SUM(TOTAL_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_AMT FROM ORDERS WHERE ORDER_STATUS != 'CANCELLED' GROUP BY TRUNC(ORDER_DATE) ) O ON D.SALE_DATE = O.ORD_DATE ORDER BY D.SALE_DATE

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT C.CUSTOMER_ID, C.CUSTOMER_NAME, O.ORDER_ID, TO_CHAR(O.ORDER_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ORDER_DATE, O.TOTAL_AMOUNT, O.ORDER_STATUS, GREATEST(O.TOTAL_AMOUNT, NVL(O.TAX_AMOUNT, 0)) AS GREATER_AMT, LEAST(O.TOTAL_AMOUNT, NVL(C.CREDIT_LIMIT, 0)) AS LESSER_AMT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY C.CUSTOMER_ID ORDER BY O.ORDER_DATE DESC) AS RN FROM CUSTOMERS C JOIN ORDERS O ON C.CUSTOMER_ID = O.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE O.ORDER_STATUS != 'CANCELLED' ) WHERE RN = 1 ORDER BY CUSTOMER_NAME
mapper.update: UPDATE ORDERS SET ORDER_STATUS = 'CANCELLED', REMARKS = NVL(REMARKS, '') || CHR(10) || '[취소] ' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') || ' ' || NVL(#{cancelReason}, '사유 미입력'), UPD_DATE = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId} AND ORDER_STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED')
